targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-960 (2026-08-29) does NOT bear on MECH-143 and its recorded evidence_direction of does_not_support should be corrected to non_contributory. The driver pre-registers MIN_DISPERSION = 0.02 on the cross-position z_world dispersion and states its meaning explicitly: below it, 'the 8 probe positions are not even distinguishable from one another and any low map_drift reading would be a representation-collapse artifact, not evidence of value-invariance.' Measured pre_dispersion was 0.009649 / 0.007550 / 0.000256 -- every cell 2x to 78x BELOW the floor, and the manifest duly records non_degenerate: false. C1 (value-stability) therefore PASSES vacuously, because a collapsed latent cannot drift under any manipulation, and C2 (location-sensitivity) FAILS for the same reason rather than for want of a value-free map. Seed 13, the most collapsed cell (0.000256), produced the run's only negative pairwise delta (-0.0805) and its only C1-failing value drift (0.2269) -- noise on a degenerate representation. The per-cell guard cell_ok = pre_dispersion >= MIN_DISPERSION is computed at driver line 384 but is neither recorded in the manifest nor used to gate the emitted direction.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-961 (2026-08-29) is a genuine but low-powered negative for MECH-144 and SHOULD be scored, despite carrying non_degenerate: false. That flag is a FALSE POSITIVE caused by a driver bug: at line 596 the driver builds geom_dist_groups = [[r['distance_std']] for ...], i.e. a list of SINGLETON groups, and passes it to metric_groups_are_degenerate, the WITHIN-group variant intended for multi-value groups such as [arm_on, arm_off] per seed. A singleton list has spread = max - min = 0 <= eps (1e-9) by definition, so every group is 'pinned' unconditionally and the check would fire identically on a perfect run. The readiness it purports to test is in fact sound: 32 active centers (floor 4) and distance_std 1.2100 / 1.0938 / 1.0408 (floor 0.5), all far above the 1e-6 degeneracy floor. On the substance, C1 (Pearson r of harm-discriminative valence against hazard proximity) measured -0.1937 / 0.1523 / 0.2150 against a pre-registered 0.35, passing 0/3 seeds with one negative. C2 (ablated null) carries no discriminative weight and the driver says so: ARM_ABLATED's evaluate_valence 'returns identically zero by construction', r is defined as 0.0 by the guarded helper, and C2 is 'recorded as a sanity check on the harness rather than a novel discriminative claim'. C1 is therefore the sole load-bearing criterion, and at 3 seeds this is a weak negative -- does_not_support at this scale and design, not a refutation.

It is honestly scoped, not a concealed vacuity. The consequence for adjudication -- C2 carries no discriminative weight, so C1 alone is load-bearing -- is retained.

learning_extracted: A within-group degeneracy helper fed SINGLETON groups always reports degenerate. Any caller of metric_groups_are_degenerate must pass genuinely multi-valued groups; a per-seed scalar belongs in the flat metric_is_degenerate variant.
A false-positive degeneracy stamp is as damaging as a missed one, in the opposite direction: it invites governance to discard a sound negative result.
The degeneracy net is recorded but not wired to evidence_direction in either direction -- see the cluster read.

cluster_pattern.shape: Both runs carry non_degenerate: false AND emit a claim-weighting evidence_direction of does_not_support. The two underlying causes are OPPOSITE: V3-EXQ-960's degeneracy flag is true and correct (a real representation collapse, 2x-78x below its own pre-registered floor) and its direction should therefore be non_contributory; V3-EXQ-961's flag is a false positive from a singleton-group driver bug, and its does_not_support direction is defensible and should be SCORED.
cluster_pattern.structural_property: The non-degeneracy scoring net is COMPUTED and RECORDED but NOT WIRED to evidence_direction. Nothing in either driver, and nothing downstream, prevents a run flagged non_degenerate: false from weighing against a claim; and nothing checks that the flag itself was computed on a well-formed input. Two independently authored drivers landed on the same day exhibit the two opposite failure directions of that single missing coupling -- one degenerate run credited as evidence, one sound run stamped degenerate.
